hooks.name: fuzz-noise-channel
hooks.description: On every codec change in the Rust crate: fuzz the acoustic channels (4-FSK: white noise 20 → 6 dB SNR, random mic gain, 44.1/48 kHz, ±300 ppm drift, room echo; OFDM: 12–20 dB SNR, echo, ±300 ppm drift on 33 s bursts, clipping), the optical fountain (100 seeds, 30/40/50 % lost) and GPKT v2 / ChromaCrypt / wide fountain / vault.

action.command: cargo test --release --manifest-path crates/ghostpacket-core/Cargo.toml --lib --test noise_fsk_fuzz --test optical_fountain_fuzz --test noise_ofdm_fuzz --test gpkt_v2
